steps.body: Break each number into hundreds, tens, and ones, then combine each spot separately. 324 + 251: hundreds 300+200=500, tens 20+50=70, ones 4+1=5. Combine: 500+70+5=575.
Combine the piles place by place, then build the answer.

commonBuilds.feedback: Check the cubes: 4 + 1 = 5, not 6. Combine each place on its own: 5 flats, 7 rods, 5 cubes.
The rods: 2 + 5 = 7 — both addends bring rods to the pile. 5 flats, 7 rods, 5 cubes.

widget.missFeedback: Add each place by itself: 3+2 flats, 2+5 rods, 4+1 cubes.
widget.successFeedback: 575 — each place added on its own, no pile spilling over. Place-by-place is the whole algorithm; trading is just what happens when a pile hits ten.

predict.prompt: 324 + 251, combined by place: 3+2 flats, 2+5 rods, 4+1 cubes. Will any pile overflow (reach 10 or more)?
predict.reveal: 5 flats, 7 rods, 5 cubes — every pile stays under ten, so the sum reads straight off as 575. Enjoy it: the very next problem, 247 + 186, has 7 + 6 = 13 cubes waiting in the ones — that pile WILL overflow past ten, and that's where trading starts.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents add by place.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for add by place must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines add by place.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

steps.body: Sometimes a spot's total is too big for one digit — 10 or more ones means trading 10 ones for 1 ten before you combine everything.

commonErrors.feedback: The ones add to 13 — trade 10 ones for 1 extra ten, then combine: 400+30+3=433.
Don't forget the traded ten from the ones! Ones: 7+6=13, trade 10 for 1 ten. Combine: 433.

steps.body: A trade can cascade — if the tens spot then also has 10 or more, trade 10 tens for 1 hundred too, just like before.

commonErrors.feedback: The ones add to 15 (trade 1 ten), then tens add to 12 (trade 1 hundred). Combine carefully: 625.
Work through each trade one at a time. The final combined answer is 625.

steps.body: Add by combining each spot separately, trading 10 of a spot for 1 of the next spot over whenever a spot overflows.
takeaways: Combine hundreds, tens, and ones each on their own.
A spot with 10 or more trades into the next spot over.
A trade can cascade through more than one spot.
